result:
Implemented Section 5 (Transcribe/Speech):

- **`app/speech.ts`** — new module wrapping `SFSpeechRecognizer`/`SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` for auth status, requesting access, and streaming transcription (partial + final results) of the bundled file.
- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired to `speech.ts`: status line reflects not-requested/granted/denied, `Transcribe Sample` enables only when granted and idle, live partial text streams into the transcript area, and on completion shows the final text plus `Completed in N.N s`. Errors surface in the status line and re-enable the button.
- **`app/assets/sample.wav`** — copied from `spec-assets/sample.wav` so the Vite plugin bundles it into the app (confirmed it lands at `<bundle>/app/assets/sample.wav`, which `speech.ts` resolves via `knownFolders.currentApp().path`).
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — added a reference to the Speech framework's iOS type declarations.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`.

`ns build ios` succeeds, and I launched the app on the simulator to confirm it installs, runs, and stays alive with no crashes or errors in the device logs.
